title: So Did We Agree or Not
gist_ar: مشهد فيه حذف كتير: تلاتة فاكرين إنهم اتفقوا، وكل واحد فاهم حاجة.

before_listening.en: A scene where almost nothing is said in full. Three people. Listen for what they have NOT agreed.
before_listening.ar: مشهد مفيهوش جمل كاملة تقريبًا. تلات أشخاص. ركّز على إيه اللي متفقوش عليه.

segments.speaker: Rania
segments.text: Pilot first, then rollout. Yes?

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: Hala
segments.text: Same.

segments.speaker: Rania
segments.text: Good. So that's the two northern districts done by March and if they're fine, the rest in the summer.

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: Sorry — the two?

segments.speaker: Rania
segments.text: The pilot. The two.

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: I had the pilot as one. The other one's in the rollout, so it doesn't wait.

segments.speaker: Hala
segments.text: Neither did I. One.

segments.speaker: Rania
segments.text: You did? Both of you?

segments.speaker: Hala
segments.text: Well — I assumed. Nobody said otherwise.

segments.speaker: Rania
segments.text: Nobody said anything, that's the trouble. We've all been nodding at a word.

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: Does it matter that much? One or two, it's the same programme.

segments.speaker: Rania
segments.text: It's a district. It's four thousand people and a budget line. So yes.

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: Fair enough. Point taken.

segments.speaker: Hala
segments.text: Can I say — I'd rather we sorted it now than found out in April. We've done that before and it cost us a quarter.

segments.speaker: Rania
segments.text: Precisely. So: one or two, out loud, and somebody writes it down. Tarek?

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: Two. If it's four thousand people, two.

segments.speaker: Hala
segments.text: Two. And I'll minute it this time.

segments.speaker: Rania
segments.text: And while we're here — the summer date. Is that all of the rest, or the rest minus the two we've just been arguing about?

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: ...See, now I don't know.

segments.speaker: Hala
segments.text: Nor do I, and I wrote the timeline.

segments.speaker: Rania
segments.text: Right. So we have two words doing this to us. 'Pilot' and 'the rest'.

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: Shall we just list the districts? Names and dates, one page, no nouns that can mean two things.

segments.speaker: Hala
segments.text: Yes. And circulate it before anybody says the word 'rollout' again.

segments.speaker: Rania
segments.text: Agreed. And Tarek — no offence meant — if it lands and it doesn't match what you think you agreed, say so that day. Not in April.

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: Fair. That one's on me last time, I'll own it.

segments.speaker: Hala
segments.text: Then we're done. One page, names and dates, by Friday.

gist_question.q: What had they not actually agreed?
gist_question.q_ar: إيه اللي مكانوش متفقين عليه فعلًا؟
options: Whether to run a pilot at all before committing to the summer rollout
What counted as the pilot — one district or two
They had all been nodding at the same word meaning different things
That it is a district — four thousand people and a budget line

questions.q: What does Hala say happened before?
questions.q_ar: هالة قالت إيه اللي حصل قبل كده؟
options: They found out late and it cost them a quarter
They ran the pilot twice and had to repeat the whole northern rollout
